questionText: Given int[] age = new int[2] { 3, 5 };, swap both ages around. (3 lines of code)
correctAnswer: int temp = age[0]; age[0] = age[1]; age[1] = temp;
explanation: Imagine each box as a glass of 2 different juices. You cannot swap the juices cleanly without a third, empty glass. (glass = juice;) You pour age[0] into the temp glass, pour age[1] into age[0], then pour age[0] from the temp glass into the age[1] glass.

questionText: Given int[] age = new int[7] { 23,2,15,-10,11,13,4 };, find the sum. (4 lines of code)
correctAnswer: foreach (int i in age) { sum = sum + i; }
explanation: i is the value inside the array element. age[i] is the index, the numbered box.

Given int[] age = new int[7] { 23,2,15,-10,11,13,4 };, find the highest. (7 lines of code)
correctAnswer: int highest = age[0]; foreach (int i in age) { if (i > highest) { highest = i; } }
explanation: Set highest to the first value. Loop through each element. For each, check if the current value inside is higher than the current value of highest (which starts at 0). If higher, make the current value the new highest. If not, do nothing. Repeat for the following elements.

questionText: Given int[] age = new int[7] { 23,2,15,-10,11,13,4 };, find the sum of odd/even numbers. (10 lines of code)
correctAnswer: foreach (int i in age) { if (i % 2 == 0) { sumEven = sumEven + i; } else { sumOdd = sumOdd + i; } }
explanation: Loop through each element. For each, check if the current value inside is cleanly divisble by 2. If yes, add its value to the current sumEven. If not, add its value to the current sumOdd. Repeat for the following elements.

questionText: Given int[] age = new int[7] { 23,2,15,-10,11,13,4 };, find the highest of odd/even numbers. (10 lines of code)
correctAnswer: int highestEven = int.MinValue; int highestOdd = int.MinValue; foreach (int i in age) { if (i % 2 == 0) { if (i > highestEven) { highestEven = i; } }  else { if (i > highestOdd) { highestOdd = i; } } }
explanation: Loop through each element. For each, check if the current value inside is cleanly divisible by 2. If yes, check if it is higher than the current highestEven. If yes, make it the new highestEven. If not, do nothing. If value is not divisible by 2, repeat checks but for highestOdd.
